module: Auxiliary kingpin controller of a semi-trailer. It only answers the tractor's `couplings/fifthwheel` controller: if the fifth wheel's key matches its own, it returns its node cid and its world position. It can also display its node in debug when the fifth wheel requests the indicator display.
notes: Jbeam keys read by init: `kingpinNode` (node name, resolved via `beamstate.nodeNameMap`) and `kingpinKey` ("fifthwheel_v2" by default, must be identical to the fifth wheel's `fifthwheelKey`).
No update: everything is done through remote calls (`obj:queueObjectLuaCommand` from the tractor).
`M.debugDraw` is nil by default; setKingpinVisibility sets or removes it then calls `controller.cacheAllControllerFunctions()`.

debugDraw.desc: nil by default; drawing function of the kingpin node when the indicator is visible.

sendDataToVehicle.desc: Called remotely by a fifth wheel: if `couplerTag` equals this kingpin's key, returns {nodeId, nodePosition} to `kingpinDataCallback` of the requesting vehicle's fifth wheel controller.

controllerName.desc: Name of the fifth wheel controller to call back.

setKingpinVisibility.desc: Enables or removes the kingpin node debug display if the key matches.

init.desc: Finds the kingpin node by name and reads the key.
